name: dsh-tauri
description: Linux-first Tauri 2 desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness: deep support for Linux distributions and versions with the best compatibility, performance and lowest resource usage, and the only platform fully adapted and verified; Windows/macOS have basic support (builds and runs, with no in-depth adaptation or optimization; users are advised to download the official desktop build from official channels); mobile (iOS/Android) is not supported because the architecture depends on a local Node service plus the system WebView, which does not fit mobile sandbox and background restrictions. Runs the official @deepseek-ai/dsh npm package (dsh web, a plain Node service) and provides the window, tray, menu, native capabilities and first-launch automatic runtime install with background updates through Rust and the system WebView — no Electron or DSH Desktop installation required.

scripts.verify:fast: npm run check && npm run check:docs && npm run check:versions && npm run check:locales && npm run check:links && npm run check:commands && npm run test:unit && npm run test:contract
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:fast && npm run lint:rust && npm run build:check && npm run cargo -- test
scripts.verify:e2e: npm run verify:all && npm run test:clean
